# Rotated groups

Original fixture generated by `tools/group_rotation_fixture.py` from the
project's original shape and picture controls. No corpus artwork is included.
The reference application exported the unchanged source to the eight-page PDF.
`tools/record_group_rotation.py` records native stable color samples and visible
bounds, binding both files by SHA-256.

Sixteen cases cover signed angles, quarter turns, both sides of 45 degrees,
all scale-axis interval endpoints, nonuniform nested groups with nonzero child
origins, reflected shapes, pictures, independently rotated children, curves and
ellipses. The browser requires exact stable colors and bounds within 1 point,
then repeats after editing, undo and reopening. Unit checks preserve scene data
and untouched package parts and reject invalid angles.

The native controls confirm that each group's frame is resized before rotation,
with scale axes exchanged in [45,135) and [225,315) degrees. Its orientation
composes with ancestor orientation; it does not reset it. Outlines retain their
physical width. This follows the established line/picture/shape compatibility
rule, rather than applying anisotropic ancestor scale after rotation.
Text in rotated groups is now independently verified by `rotated-shape-text`.
Text in reflected groups retains its separate strict-import guard.
